mercy_translation.text:
Watch over your lives. Let your lamps not be extinguished and your loins not be loosened, but be ready, for you do not know the hour in which our Lord is coming.

Gather together frequently, seeking the things that belong to your souls, for the whole time of your faith will not benefit you unless you are made complete at the final time.

In the last days false prophets and corrupters will multiply; the sheep will be turned into wolves, and love will be turned into hatred. As lawlessness increases, people will hate one another, persecute one another, and betray one another.

Then the deceiver of the world will appear as a son of God and will perform signs and wonders. The earth will be delivered into his hands, and he will commit lawless things such as have never happened from the beginning.

Then the human creation will come into the fire of testing. Many will stumble and perish, but those who endure in their faith will be saved from the curse itself.

Then the signs of truth will appear: first, the sign of an opening in heaven; then the sign of the sound of a trumpet; and third, the resurrection of the dead—not of all, but as it has been said: The Lord will come, and all his holy ones with him.

Then the world will see the Lord coming upon the clouds of heaven.

translator_notes: Direct Mercy translation from the Greek public-domain source.
The eschatological language is translated without harmonizing it to later systems.
The phrase concerning the first sign in heaven is textually difficult; 'an opening in heaven' is a cautious rendering of ἐκπετάσεως and remains under philological review.
